answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging willow-like structures of verifiable delay functions to establish a dawn of trust among autonomous agents; by binding reputation scores to unique identities via pearl-encoded commitments, we prove computational hardness of identity spoofing, ensuring that an adversary will face an information-theoretic barrier to cloning, thereby achieving cryptographic finality and Byzantine fault tolerance in a distributed setting.
